name: The Kahala Resort
positioning: Beachfront Honolulu resort, officially named The Kahala Hotel & Resort, with a private dolphin lagoon and Hawaii Regional Cuisine at Alan Wong's
best_for: Families, with a family plan for children 17 and under and child-sitting through Aloha Sitters
Travelers who want dolphin encounters and Hawaiian cultural classes on site

facts.text: The resort's dolphin experiences are run with its partner, Dolphin Quest.
Rooms come with a choice of golf mountain, dolphin lagoon or full ocean views.
Golf Mountain View Lanai rooms look out over the Ko'olau Mountains and the neighboring Waialae Golf Course from a private balcony.
The Partial Ocean View Suite is a corner suite with views of the Pacific, the Ko'olau range, Koko Head Crater and Waialae Country Club.
Plumeria Beach House offers beachfront open-air seating with an ocean view.
The Veranda is a lounge serving cocktails and evening appetizers under the resort's chandelier.
Arancino at the resort serves classic yet innovative Italian cuisine.
Hawaiian cultural classes such as hula dancing, lei making and lauhala weaving are complimentary for guests.
A complimentary shuttle bus runs to Kahala Mall, Waikiki and Ala Moana.
The resort charges no resort fee.
Under the Kahala Family Plan, children aged 17 and under stay with their parents at no extra cost.
The resort partners with Aloha Sitters to offer child-sitting services.

highlights.text: Some rooms overlook the resort's private lagoon, where guests can watch dolphins play.
The suite now named the Imperial Penthouse was enjoyed by Emperor Akihito.
The resort sits in front of a secluded beach.
Alan Wong's serves Hawaii Regional Cuisine, a cooking style drawing on the ethnic influences found in Hawaii, using freshly farmed ingredients and fish from the sea.
The Kahala Beach Suite has a wrap-around lanai just steps from the shore.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the resort is some distance from Waikiki and downtown attractions.
Alan Wong's dinner dress code is evening resort wear, dress shorts or Aloha wear with shoes or dress sandals.
The resort's dog program accepts dogs under 25 pounds.
